justification: The witness is valid: any tour cheaper than 50 must contain all three zero edges and avoid weight-100 edges. The balance equations then force T', costing 45 and replacing five edges, so T is 4-Opt but not globally optimal. Relabeling vertices (1,…,8) as (G,A,F,E,B,D,C,H) gives the reference’s tour pair and low-weight edge graph, with different weights and the same failure mechanism.
